nodes.name: Fetch Token Usage by Clinic and Model

parameters.query: SELECT clinic_id, COUNT(*)::bigint AS recorded_model_calls, COUNT(DISTINCT conversation_id)::bigint AS conversations, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0)::bigint AS prompt_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0)::bigint AS completion_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0)::bigint AS total_tokens, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE metadata->>'model_node' = 'DeepSeek Model')::bigint AS deepseek_model_calls, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens) FILTER (WHERE metadata->>'model_node' = 'DeepSeek Model'), 0)::bigint AS deepseek_model_prompt_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens) FILTER (WHERE metadata->>'model_node' = 'DeepSeek Model'), 0)::bigint AS deepseek_model_completion_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens) FILTER (WHERE metadata->>'model_node' = 'DeepSeek Model'), 0)::bigint AS deepseek_model_total_tokens, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE metadata->>'model_node' = 'DeepSeek Result Model')::bigint AS deepseek_result_model_calls, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens) FILTER (WHERE metadata->>'model_node' = 'DeepSeek Result Model'), 0)::bigint AS deepseek_result_model_prompt_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens) FILTER (WHERE metadata->>'model_node' = 'DeepSeek Result Model'), 0)::bigint AS deepseek_result_model_completion_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens) FILTER (WHERE metadata->>'model_node' = 'DeepSeek Result Model'), 0)::bigint AS deepseek_result_model_total_tokens FROM public.ai_requests WHERE provider = 'deepseek' GROUP BY clinic_id ORDER BY total_tokens DESC LIMIT 1000
